security: NASDAQ:PLTR Class A; all economic share classes counted
sbc_treatment: Cash replacement: future SBC treated as ongoing cash compensation within GAAP-like EBIT, with no SBC cashflow add-back or future issuance. Existing awards diluted separately; conservative full vesting RSU/options; SAR approximation reserved.
base_2026_basis: August 3 release FY guidance midpoint; guidance not fact

low.narrative: AI commercialization slows, government procurement delays and implementation costs compress margins; receivables absorb cash.

base.narrative: Commercial adoption remains strong but decelerates; government expansion moderates; cash compensation retained and terminal economics mature.

high.narrative: Deployment repeatability drives sustained adoption and collection efficiency; terminal margin still below peak.

capital_cost.beta_basis: Analyst risk assumption; not estimated regression. Cash-rich firm beta should not be mechanically applied to operating enterprise. Sensitivity covers 8-13%.
capital_cost.riskfree_maturity: 10-year Treasury par yield (as stated in the memo)
capital_cost.riskfree_verification: pending: home.treasury.gov blocked in the 2026-10-20 session; see docs/source-verification-2026-10-20.md
capital_cost.erp_verification: pending: Damodaran page blocked in the 2026-10-20 session; a secondary report dates 4.20% to July 2026
capital_cost.beta_sourced_estimate: pending: no provider or regression estimate retrievable in the 2026-10-20 session

terminal_fade.path: linear from the 2030 forecast growth and input margin toward each case's terminal growth and terminal margin; fade year k of n is k/(n+1) of the way
terminal_fade.basis: Analyst assumption pending Pierce's decision. base_years 0 keeps the frozen immediate-maturity convention; 5 and 10 are reported comparisons. Fade ROIC equals the mature terminal ROIC (assumption).

named_path.label: Maturity deferred to2035 with five-year fade
named_path.basis: Delayed-maturity comparison only (reported as a named stress); not the base-case terminal convention.

model_qualifications: Cash-replacement pro-forma is analytically normalized, not a forecast of GAAP SBC equity accounting.
Noncontrolling income/distributions set to zero prospectively; opening NCI held fixed.
Current lease balances remain in aggregated accruals; expense stays operating.
Other noncurrent operating balances held fixed; not a granular lease/revenue tax-asset forecast.

procurement_shock.label: Procurement delay and AI deployment failure
procurement_shock.basis: Analyst stress path, not a forecast

corrections.basis: Post-comparison code corrections (Claude Code, 2026-10-20). Set false only to reproduce the frozen October 6 calculation in the valuation bridge.

nol.source: 2025 10-K income tax note (data/processed/pltr_2025_10k_issuer.txt): federal NOLs about $9.0B, of which $8.3B indefinite; state about $4.8B; annual limitation caveat stated by the company
nol.basis: Sensitivity only. Assumes no NOL use in reported H1 2026 (1.4% 2025 effective rate; H1 2026 tax $27.6M). The state rate and 80% state cap are simplifications. Section 382 limits and expiries are represented only through the availability share.

peer_policy.growth_diagnostic: year-to-date revenue growth on the same window as the TTM build

interest_yield_basis: Assumption 3.0%; realized H1 2026 interest income is about 3.5% annualized on average cash + marketable securities (all Treasuries mature within one year), see docs/source-verification-2026-10-20.md
